title: Demo · Breach of trust under the BNS, arrest without notice, papers missing
story: Accused-1, an accountant, is charged under BNS 316(2) for diverting Rs. 3,80,000 of his employer's collections, an offence punishable with up to five years. He was arrested on 05.10.2026 without a notice of appearance and without recorded reasons; counsel has only four papers, so intake asks what is missing and counsel answers from instructions.

variant.offence: BNS 316(2) criminal breach of trust (maximum 5 years), offence after 1 July 2024
variant.custody: arrest without a notice of appearance or recorded reasons (BNSS s.35(3), Arnesh Kumar; the radar shows UNKNOWN for the notice rule); default-bail window not yet open (NOT_YET: day 41 of 60 on the recording date, 15.11.2026; the right arises on day 61); BNSS s.479 stays CHECK because antecedents are unknown
variant.record: four documents only: charge-sheet status, custody certificate, antecedents and earlier orders are missing, so intake asks
variant.parity: no co-accused; first-time offender (by counsel's answer); no earlier bail application

steps.title: Rights Radar
steps.caption: At intake Peshkar ran the 7 rules of the Rights Radar on the dossier as of 2026-11-15: date arithmetic and statute tables, not the language model. Default bail: NOT_YET, Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479): CHECK, Production within 24 hours: CHECK and Antil category: CHECK. Each result names its rule and the dates it used; rules not yet re-checked against the bare act are marked unverified.

filled.label: Default bail
filled.value: NOT_YET: 60-day limit (maximum 5 years). Day 1 is the first remand, 06.10.2026. As of 15.11.2026 it is day 41. The right arises on day 61 (05.12.2026), 20 day(s) from now, if no charge sheet is filed.

filled.label: Undertrial limit (BNSS s.479)
filled.value: CHECK: 41 days in custody. The threshold is 609 days for a first-time offender (1/3 of 5 years, on bond) and 913 days otherwise (1/2, on bail). Antecedents unknown.

filled.label: Notice of appearance
filled.value: UNKNOWN: Offence punishable up to 7 years. No arrest memo or notice in the file.

filled.label: Grounds of arrest
filled.value: UNKNOWN: No record that the grounds of arrest were communicated.

filled.label: Production within 24 hours
filled.value: CHECK: Produced the next day; times not on record.

filled.label: Antil category
filled.value: CHECK: Category A (up to 5 years), unless treated as an economic offence (D). Antil's categories decide how an accused who was not arrested during investigation and cooperated is treated after the charge sheet; for a client in custody this is context, not a bail entitlement.

filled.label: Statutory bar
filled.value: NOT_APPLICABLE: No NDPS, UAPA or PMLA section is charged.
